description: A suite of six parallel, gently convex ridges with intervening concave troughs, each ridge ~0.5m high, 150–250m long and spaced ~20–30m apart. Orientation is roughly NE–SW. The pattern and dimensions are consistent with paired raised‐field agriculture and associated drainage canals.

A single straight, shallow concave channel ~180m long, <1m deep, trending E–W. Curvature filtering isolates it as a second‐order concavity; hillshade shows sharply defined edges. NIR composites show persistent higher moisture retention along its axis.
